source.title: WCA Championship 2024 and 2025 Hosts Announcement (August 2023)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that **Seattle, United States** will be hosting the upcoming **WCA World Championship** in 2025 and **Buenos Aires, Argentina** will be hosting the upcoming **WCA South American Championship** in 2024.

We would like to thank Astana, Kazakhstan for applying for the WCA World Championship 2025. Unfortunately, no bids were received for the African, Asian or Oceanic Championships in 2024.  Any teams interested in organizing these competitions should reach out to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org)

You can view the application documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JIHlbGzATd-TH6pi696GSzlkp5IsLkrz) (WCA World Championship) and [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_SVg3Qhui1qWyCrY6xI9qKUExTcgrusk) (WCA South American Championship).

translation.title: 2024 及 2025 年 WCA 锦标赛举办地公告（2023 年 8 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，2025 年 **WCA 世界锦标赛**将在**美国西雅图**举行，2024 年 **WCA 南美洲锦标赛**将在**阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯**举行。

感谢哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳申请承办 2025 年 WCA 世界锦标赛。遗憾的是，我们未收到 2024 年非洲、亚洲或大洋洲锦标赛的承办申请。有意组织这些比赛的团队，请联系 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料可分别在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JIHlbGzATd-TH6pi696GSzlkp5IsLkrz)（WCA 世界锦标赛）及[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_SVg3Qhui1qWyCrY6xI9qKUExTcgrusk)（WCA 南美洲锦标赛）查看。
